notes.title: MEANDERS - Summer Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/e4cd008ab332796c4dbfc578a63e5121ebc1b48c.gif[/img]
Hi all!
[b]Update 8 is live![/b]

[h1][b]INTRODUCING... BEACH BALLS!![/b][/h1]
To kick Summer in the right direction and celebrate the awesome Summer Sales we introduce... the Beach Ball skin!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/7b94dc4ed537989e2de882e67a07a96cf41be45c.png[/img]
[h1][b]NEW "SHARPEN" VISUAL FILTER[/b][/h1]
You like clarity and sharpness when you play? Well, this visual filter is for you!

[h1][b]WORLD MODES POSTPONED[/b][/h1]
Due to the recent feedback, we have decided to indefinitely postpone MEANDERS World Modes.

We have removed the corresponding tab from the Atomic Stuff Menu since both modes are going to be reworked from scratch, in order for them to achieve a more interesting gameplay that differs significantly from the main game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/64e8d43cdfd23b259e350a53058077f8acd19b0a.png[/img]
At the same, we didn't completely remove the current code from the game so, if you want to give the discarded "Pimp My Meanders" mode a try - to see how it looked like or to give us your feedback - you can:
1. Press F10 while in-game to open the Console
2. Type the command "pimp" to either enable or disable this mode (works only if used while in the pause menu).

Thanks!

[h1][b]LOCALIZATION UPDATE[/b][/h1]
Our translation and localization efforts continue, thank you all for the support so far!
[b]Updated:[/b] [i]Catalan, Czech, Danish, Dutch, German, Hungarian, Spanish, Ukrainian[/i]
[b]New:[/b] [i]Bulgarian, Chinese (Simplified), French, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil)[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/e9c8502f6c66330e69c7771c6033034c961493e9.png[/img]

[h1][b]CHANGELOG 1.8.1[/b][/h1]
*Added Beach Ball Skin
*Added Sharpen Visual Filter
*Now a Speedrun can be restarted instantly after its completion without having to wait for the Rankboard opening
*The "Reset" shortcut key can now be used to restart a Speedrun even on the Rankboard Menu
*Fixed a bug with Serious Meanders' "Air Blast" cooldown timer when pausing the game
*Fixed a bug with medals unlocking on level 40
*Improved gamepad and mouse navigation for the Main Menu
*Improved visibility for Main Menu buttons
*Improved Main Menu titles alignment and sizes

Best,
ATOMIC BREATH

notes.title: MINOR FIXES + CALL FOR TRANSLATOR
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/0dfaf555f1d5371e5f218a27a29373a4217c7960.png[/img]

Hi all!
It’s update time!

[h1][b] 1.7.3 MINOR FIXES[/b][/h1]
Version 1.7.3 is live which fixes various errors with accented or special character letters across several languages!
Also, Leaderboards were not working properly and we fixed them real quick!
With this version, we also introduced the [i]Credits[/i] section :D

[h1][b]CALL FOR TRANSLATORS[/b][/h1]
Thanks to a lot of community efforts, in less than two months since our first call for help we translated MEANDERS to so many languages, and many are yet to come!

Giving a hand is super-easy, and even if you have just 10 minutes to dedicate to this we’d be grateful for your time.

But what should you do in practice?
[OLIST]
[*]Go to this link: http://atomicbreath.oneskyapp.com/collaboration/
[*]Select in which manner you would like to help us, namely:
[*]Game texts (1100 Words)
[*]Steam Page texts (96 Words)
[*]Achievements texts (238 Words)
[*]Select which language you want to translate it to (If your language is not listed, please report to us)
[*]Create an account for free to start translating!
[*]Thanks!!
[/OLIST]

[h1][b]TO ALL OUR CONTRIBUTING TRANSLATORS[/b][/h1]
[b]Please check OneSky, we added a new line of text where you can just add your name and we'll put it as is in the credits. Thanks![/b]

Did you try the “1S1H” Mode?
It definitely adds some spice for the most challenge-seeking players, in particular, if coupled – of course – with the “Wet Souls” Mode.
 
If you enjoyed MEANDERS please leave a short review (+10 points if you make it funny).
If you think the game suc*s, please, keep it to yourself (joking: even more so, write a review so that we all know too!)

Best,
ATOMIC BREATH

notes.title: MEANDERS - SPEEDRUN MODE Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/dacfec8ea3775939606b399932db7712914e7d5c.gif[/img]

Hi there all!

[b]Update 5 is live![/b]

[h1][b]SPEEDRUN MODE & STEAM LEADERBOARDS AVAILABLE[/b][/h1]
[i]Speedrun Mode[/i] is finally here! 🎈🎈🎈
It can be started at any moment, even if you haven't yet completed the game or unlocked that specific level you wish to run.

However, completing a level during [i]Speedrun Mode[/i] does not unlock it.
This means that the base game progress and the [i]Speedrun Mode[/i] are completely separated.

While the [i]Speedrun mode[/i] is enabled you will not able to:
*Access the "Select Meander" menu
*Access the "Atomic Stuff" menu
*Use the "God Room" shortcut button
*Use the "Restart Journey" shortcut button

Once you exit [i]Speedrun Mode[/i] you automatically return to the level you were before starting the run.

[b]Bouncers Route and Cannons Route Speedrun[/b]
When reaching crossroads, "wrong" exits will be disabled, forcing you to follow the selected path.

[b]All Levels Speedrun[/b]
When reaching crossroads, it does not matter which exit you choose, you are forced to follow the "basic" levels progression (1 to 40)

There are two kinds of Leaderboards currently implemented: "ATOMIC STUFF ON" and "ATOMIC STUFF OFF"

[h1][b]CHANGELOG 1.05.8[/b][/h1]
*Added Speedrun Mode
*Added Steam Leaderboards Integration
*Revamped all game textures
*Fixed a bug with beam's particle system
*Fixed a bug with Cannon Gun charged bomb while resetting
*Slight change to Portals collision to improve instant teleportation
*Slight change to Teleports collision to improve instant teleportation
*The game now saves every time a Portal is crossed (to prevent annoying rollbacks)

[h1][b]DIFFICULTY MODES IMPLEMENTATION[/b][/h1]
Future updates are going to be focused on adding all the three remaining [i]DIFFICULTY MODES[/i] we have designed.
Keep yourself posted 😉

Best,
ATOMIC BREATH

notes.title: Becoming a human cannonball in sandbox platformer Meanders
notes.content:
I disagree with the Steam description for Meanders not because it's strictly wrong, but because it's underselling the game. Developer Atomic Breath calls it "a sparkling theme park full of platform and environmental puzzles." And fair enough, there are doors to unlock and boxes to put on pressure plates—things which would normally indicate a puzzle game—but I don't consider its levels to be puzzles. They're more like obstacle courses for one thing, and I never once stopped to think about how to solve any of them because I was too busy having fun firing myself out of cannons.

Meanders is an unabashedly simple first-person platformer whose 40-odd levels are filled with stuff to interact with. There are little red balls to throw at larger balls and through hoops, platforms and bounce pads to jump across, lasers to dodge, and conveyor belts powerful enough to send you careening into the skybox. Most importantly, there are massive platinum cannons mounted freakin' everywhere, and chaining these tools together is more fun than it has any right to be. 

The levels in this game would make Wile E. Coyote proud. Let me walk you through an average run: grab a red ball, climb into a cannon, shoot yourself and the ball through a hoop to raise a bounce pad, land inside another cannon and fire yourself into that bounce pad, then double-jump backwards mid-air (because we don't need physics where we're going), lob your ball in an arc to hit a crystal to unlock the exit, and finally fall through a rotating web of lasers onto a huge slide leading to the way out. 

Meanders is one of the most videogame-y videogames I've ever played. It's bite-sized and bare-bones, but it works because it's centrally about the simple, satisfying thrill of motion. There's a wonderful sense of speed and freedom to it, and as levels escalate into increasingly ridiculous and oversized sets, they deliver authentic adrenaline-pumping heights. Thank god there's no virtual reality version; it would probably kill you. And that's without the unlockable bonuses which add absurd physics guns and wonky visual settings.

My favorite thing is how little the game tells you (provided you pick the 'no hints' option at the start, which you totally should). It might tell you how to throw a ball or use a cannon, but you'll never know what the big red button does until you press it. Will that laser kill me if I touch it? Will that platform disappear? What happens if I break this ball? Can this cannon reach the exit? There's only one way to find out, so pull your socks up and press the button. 

Every level is a new box of questions and experiments, and failing never gets frustrating because Meanders has absolutely no loading times. None. Once you start the game, nothing stands between you and trying your stupid ideas. You cannot overestimate the value of being able to restart instantly in a game where your principle method of transportation is cannon fire. 

Meanders is only $5 on Steam, and it certainly looks like it. Every level takes place in the same minimalistic waterscape, and altogether the art takes the idea of low-poly to new extremes. But that just serves to highlight the elements that matter. Some may find the sterile aesthetic repetitive, but its pearlescent textures and detailed reflections are genuinely pretty. Besides, I value clarity over anything in a game like this. I'm also a fan of its soothing electronic soundtrack, but your mileage may vary. In any case, even if it's only two hours, I defy you not to have fun with it.

notes.title: MEANDERS - DRAGONS Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/d65de1cda0f16a631a5a93afb8059b380453c336.gif[/img]

Roaring greetings to ya all!

[b]Update 3 is live![/b]

[h1][b]DRAGONS AVAILABLE[/b][/h1]
Happy New Lunar Year to you all! For this special event, we thought of inviting over our cousins - the Chinese dragons - to play. You can activate/deactivate DRAGONS from the visual stuff menu, hope you find them super-cool! In the future we'll make other additions, such as UFOs and Kites... look forward to them!

[h1][b]MULTIPLE LANGUAGES ENABLED[/b][/h1]
We introduced the languages already translated by some incredible members of this community, a round of cheers for them all!
All languages are Work In Progress and will be tested thoroughly, but we thought of making them already available so that everyone could play them. If you have some feedback let us know!

It's not even been two days since we posted our announcement [link] asking for your help in translating the game... and so much has been translated already, really happy about that *faith in humanity over 9000*

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/7bd882459cfbe69300610769182d4154cfaf2141.gif[/img]

Of course, we will continue to fix them and introduce other languages, so if you would like to help - even just a bit, no need to take a whole project on your own - here's the link: http://atomicbreath.oneskyapp.com/

[h1][b]SHORTCUT TO THE GOD[/b][/h1]
We added a shortcut button to reach the "god room", it makes getting to the final room so much faster!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/e767527f91798e027c90ba8ef5f3170057b1b9c7.gif[/img]

The shortcut button will appear in your menu if you have already reached the final room in the current playthrough.

[h1][b]CHANGELOG 1.03.1[/b][/h1]
*Dragons Enabled
*Multiples languages enabled for testing purposes (French, Spanish, German, Polish, Simplified Chinese)
*Added a handy button in the main menu to easily reach the god room [i](you have to visit it at least one time during the current run to enable this button)[/i]
*Increased the texture pool size
*Visual improvement for Height Fog
*Fixed the audio bug in Level 17 "Slider-Bouncer"
*Fixed collision response between bouncers and physics objects
*Fixed a bug with charged ball while opening the pause menu
*Minor UI improvements

[h1][b]SECRET ENDING IN THE WORKS[/b][/h1]
We are now working on the finishing touches of MEANDERS not-so-secret ending (which we had to postpone due to our early launch): it will be announced soon!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/68f8be0371b2cbf95dce659273ec1a04cbf20429.gif[/img]

[h1][b]MEANDERS DRAGONS BUNDLE[/b][/h1]

notes.title: MEANDERS - DRY SOULS Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/6022588a5ad59e1414e608aa0eecd67cdccb2dfa.gif[/img]

Hi there all!

[b]Update 2 is live![/b]

[h1][b]DRY SOULS GAME MODE AVAILABLE[/b][/h1]
Let us introduce the first Game mode meant to increase difficulty: [b]Dry Souls![/b]
Once enabled, you will "die" and respawn every time you fall into the water. Be careful!!
Reach the Exit of a level with Dry Souls enabled and you will receive a shiny [b]Medal[/b]!

[h1][b]DIFFICULTY MODES AND MEDALS[/b][/h1]
Say what? Dry Souls is not difficult enough for you?! Well, that's awesome!
With future updates we will introduce three new [I]DIFFICULTY MODES[/I], all with their own Medals!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/e352d9d33d73350f0755319ef1c8d58bafaecad4.gif[/img]

Each [i]DIFFICULTY MODE[/i] will be playable as stand-alone, but it will also be possible to stack several (if not all) of these modes together to increase difficulty [i]EXPONENTIALLY[/i] and create the [i]ULTIMATE CHALLENGE[/i].

[h1][b]CHANGELOG 1.02.3[/b][/h1]
*Fixed a bug when using "Select Meander" while the character is inside a cannon
*Fixed the unlocking of all the "Meander Cleared" related achievements
*Fixed the cannon gun bug when entering a cannon al full charge (Serious M mode)

*It is no longer possible to spawn mini-cannons on Collapsers (timed platforms) (Serious M mode)
*Moving Targets on Level 24 "Towered" will now reset to their original position when the level is reset

[h1][b]NEW VISUAL STUFF[/b][/h1]
To celebrate the upcoming Lunar New Year we will introduce...[b]Dragons![/b]
